method.timing: operation start until rendering finished and the next frame was produced (rAF + MessageChannel); frame rate limit disabled except for ingest and orbit scenarios
method.memory: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after forced GC: V8 heap + Blink heap + ArrayBuffer backing stores
method.processMemory: separate runs, one fresh page per sample, each a first mount from data prepared to charts mounted, readings after forced GC and a 500 ms pause: firstRetainedBytes = heap as above; rendererBytes = the page's renderer process phys_footprint (macOS footprint); gpuBytes = GPU memory the renderer's memory-infra dump lists (webgl buffers and drawing buffers, canvas resources shared with the GPU process, cc tile memory); gpuProcessBytes = the GPU process's phys_footprint
method.webglDone: second run of each frame-timed scenario in a fresh page: operation start until the frame and then a 1-pixel readPixels on every live WebGL context the page created (waits for their GPU work); 2D canvas and compositor rasterization on the GPU are not waited for
